name: Bonded (Magic Armor or Shield Quality)
body:
Aura moderate conjuration; CL 9th; Price +2,500 gp; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

These sets or armor or shields were made for those who need to be ready at a moment’s notice. Bonded armor and shields are keyed to a charm which can be attached to a necklace, bracelet, or article of clothing. As long as the charm and bonded shield or suit of armor are on the same plane the holder of the charm can teleport the armor or shield any distance to themselves as a move action. If not wielding a shield or wearing a suit of armor the item automatically dons itself to the caller.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor, teleport
